It contains the identity and all restrictions, and nothing in it trivialises ChartIso. I checked the proof route mathematically. chartIso_of_isoNear localises ChartIso for causalities absolutely minimal on every open set; it is the same argument as Causal.chartIso_of_mem_maximalAtlas, run through imp_of_agree_locally. chartIso_aeAtlas shows each maximal a.e. atlas chart is locally g • (sector chart ∘ toPaper), via Model's btz_chart_eq_smul_btzPaperDev and Causal.ChartIso.agreeOn_of_smul. isoNear_of_mem_e0Groupoid_reg handles the regular points (agreeOn_of_regular). chartIso_paperConj/chartIso_of_axis handle the BTZ points. The orientation on the axis is forced by a chronological ray and closed J⁻ (orientation_axis); the junction comes from le_ends_of_leaves; and chronological curves never meet the axis after their start (Lt.not_mem_axis). As the REPORT says, no rigidity hypothesis is used. summary: Verdict: clean. The file builds with 0 sorry, is up to date under lake build --no-build, and every one of its 372 declarations uses only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. This round's one change is the LocalModel field chartIso_mem, now proved as GX.E0.chartIso_mem_e0Groupoid. Its type is verbatim LocalModel's (O1) for Rigid's genuine a.e.-isomorphism groupoid, with BTZ points included, and the proof uses no rigidity hypothesis. The route is sound: localisation of ChartIso under absolute minimality, a.e.-atlas charts shown to be g • sector charts, regular points by agreeOn_of_regular, and BTZ points by the axis-preserving homeomorphism argument. Since round 1 no statement was weakened (only docstring prose was removed), so every dispatch item is now discharged unconditionally. The DEC-33 gate holds with the two new strict imports, there are no name clashes, LocalModel still typechecks downstream, and there are no marks. The single ledger row is correctly partial and unmarked. Three minors remain: the provenance line names the old lean-causal pin 731ed99 instead of ca2ad78; SCOPE (a) says btzE0Structure is unused, though the chart lemmas use it as a local instance; and CausallyOpenFuture at U ≠ ⊤ and local push-up remain disclosed deferrals, the latter proved in LocalModel.
